reviewer: Independent popup_review agent; read-only production review
head: 492d8d60084026cbc80e045301b638e4b0f76a31
scope: Remove first-code-point truncation from resolved popup action labels only. No production changes, build, ADB or push performed by reviewer.
actual_diff: PopupKeyboardUi.kt: one expression returns the existing getLabel result directly instead of branching on icon/empty/first code point. 1 insertion, 7 deletions; no imports removed because isIconFont remains used by PopupKeyUi.

contracts.finding: Predicate label.length == 1 && label[0].code < 128 and returned original label are unchanged; no new Rime/action resolution is introduced for this path.
Previously getLabel(...).let selected else ""; now getLabel directly returns the same empty string. PopupKeyUi continues to show its empty TextView. No char access occurs.

Previously the complete icon string bypassed truncation; direct getLabel preserves the identical token. PopupKeyUi still recognizes isIconFont, creates IconicsDrawable, shows ImageView and hides TextView.
All resolved code units survive, including Settings=设置 and TrimeWiki=Wiki. Action resolution and KeyboardWindow.currentKeyboard argument are unchanged.

contracts.case: supplementary emoji, combining and ZWJ strings
contracts.finding: No code-point/grapheme splitting is left on this path. getLabel output passes intact to TextView; font glyph coverage and shaping remain existing renderer behavior and require bounded Android object evidence.

PopupKeyUi still uses AutoScaleTextView.Mode.Proportional inside fixed keyWidth/keyHeight FrameLayouts; AutoScale measures whole text and scales X/Y together when content exceeds available bounds. No new scaling code or text truncation is introduced. Arbitrarily long labels may shrink; this patch does not promise a minimum readable font size.

contracts.case: action token, gesture focus and dispatch
contracts.finding: keys, labels, keyOrders, onChangeFocus and onTrigger are unchanged. onTrigger continues returning keys.getOrNull(focusedIndex), never the display label. PopupDelegate uses labels=keys as before; Settings/browser action execution itself is not changed.

contracts.case: Rime status and action label resolution
contracts.finding: getLabel already reads RimeDaemon session/status through adjustCase. Direct return does not introduce or remove such reads; any fixture must create a real ready session to exercise full path.

separate_preexisting_findings.finding: Grid capacity can undercount for 13,17,21,22 and more entries due to roundToInt(n/ceil(n/5)).
separate_preexisting_findings.disposition: Independent pre-existing behavior; not caused by full-label preservation. Should remain a separate focused fix and not block two-item issue2033 fix.

separate_preexisting_findings.finding: No universal readability/RTL/physical OEM/TalkBack acceptance has been performed by this source review.
separate_preexisting_findings.disposition: Do not claim these from bounded object render checks.

working_tree_note: app/build.gradle.kts was modified temporarily by the root-controlled build during inspection; review is bound to git objects base/head rather than that temporary build change.

public_API_checks: ThemeYaml/ThemeDslExpander, Theme.copy/PresetKey, ColorManager.attachTheme/init/setColorScheme/currentScope are public production APIs; no internal constructor invocation or reflection.

Keyboard constructor with selfConfig=null is public; KeyboardWindow.currentKeyboard is public lateinit. Helper restores original object if initialized; otherwise explicitly describes fixture state surviving only until instrumentation process finish.

RimeDaemon getFirstSessionOrNull/createSession/destroySession and RimeSession.runOnReady are public. Helper refuses any pre-existing session before creating a uniquely named own session; readiness block uses real RimeApi isReady/statusCached.

PopupKeyboardUi.root is inferred LinearLayout/ViewGroup in production, so ViewGroup assignment and direct public child traversal compile at source-contract level. TextView.text and public ImageView visibility/drawable queried, no private keyOrders/keyUis access.
Final version uses explicit public getTextScaleX() rather than Kotlin synthetic-looking textScaleX read, avoiding ambiguity with private source backing field.
onChangeFocus receives actual descendant cell rectangle center in container-local coordinates; onTrigger returns original tokens. No Activity/browser/settings launch or action dispatch is performed.
oracle_checks: Bundled default exact popup [TrimeWiki,Settings] is read from real shipped theme; resolved labels asserted Wiki/设置, expected width38/text23 match current asset.

Four scenarios: bundled38dp, narrow24dp, text46sp, five explicit preset controls. Eleven total observations, nine expected baseline complete-label violations: six bundled observations plus multi-CJK, ZWJ and combining; ASCII-A and icon remain controls.
Fixture long token PopupProbeAscii passes through real action resolution with label A, but is not a one-character ASCII shortcut input. No standalone shortcut/empty dynamic acceptance claim.

Baseline expected display uses full icon token or first code point, catches final assertion as ordinary instrumentation result. A premature readiness/parser/ink/cleanup failure cannot satisfy all_scenarios_completed + exact nine violations + expected_observation_matches.
Fixed requires eleven observations, zero label violations, original token-set equality, positive finite proportional scales <=1.001, and at least one downscaling case.

Child-only bitmap ink explicitly requires no background and positive measured dimensions, excluding a trivial popup background pass. Pixel nonemptiness and text property equality do not establish glyph-by-glyph recognition or universal readability.

PNG bitmap dimensions/pixel count, compressed output and matrix sizes bounded; unique owned directory avoids overwriting existing files. Normal retained artifacts require Root pull/hash/cleanup afterward.
lifecycle_and_failure_checks: Normal overall watchdog150s covers readiness90s/main20s and synchronous native destroy; native call cannot be cancelled by coroutine timeout, so watchdog finish and Root VM/controller cleanup remain actual hard-stop fallback.

Main Runnable captures Throwable internally and communicates by latch/Result; expected assertion does not escape main as a FATAL. Timed out already-running main task cannot be interrupted and is explicitly disclosed.

Both color preference values captured and finally restored/read back. Prior scope reattached through public APIs, with object-identity limitation explicit. No claim of full preferences-byte or native-data preservation.
Only its own Rime session is destroyed; before/after flags make early startup/teardown incomplete distinguishable. Native maintenance/user-data writes, notifications and logcat clear are disclosed.
RimeDaemon Deploy.Start calls logcat --clear. Root must preserve continuous raw external logs; a terminal ring-buffer dump cannot prove full-run warning coverage.
Atomic finished guard prevents duplicate final results; watchdog reports failed state if cleanup stalls. Expected baseline result passed=false remains distinct from unexpected harness failure.
limitations: No compile, APK inspection, ADB, real rendering or native runtime performed by this reviewer. Successful actual compilation and observed baseline/fixed JSON are still required.

Synthetic unattached production popup rendering and direct method calls do not verify physical long-press gestures, window placement, TalkBack, full IME lifecycle, user-perceived readability, or all glyph shapes.

Dynamic fixture matrix does not include an empty resolved label or literal one-character ASCII shortcut token; production source verifies those paths unchanged. No requirement to enlarge this focused patch.
Native real-session startup/deployment may change normal maintenance/config files and emits ordinary warnings; not a no-JNI or zero-runtime-warning proof.

Root must bind installed_target_apk_sha256 to baseline/fixed source identities, inspect all four PNGs per target, verify restoration/destroy flags, pull then remove own UUID directory and uninstall helper if appropriate.
